name: content-lifecycle-ext
description: Core refinements of the harness's generic content lifecycle: quality control across a folio's QA checks (placement PR1, #1702), and reviewer comments on a folio's edit-set (moved down from cat-harness, bean lthi); and the contracts two lower roles are held to in this layer's diagrams: the corpus when an accepted edit is committed, and an external registry when a source's authority is checked.
